notes:
Skip Intro and Skip Outro now work on normal TV series, not just anime.

Reelm looks up community-submitted intro and credits timestamps for the exact episode you are watching, so the Skip button now appears on ordinary shows for the first time. Anime keeps using the timings it already used, which stay more accurate for openings and endings. Every timestamp is checked against the length of your own file first, so a submission made against a different release is ignored rather than skipping you to the wrong place.

Next episode now keeps your source.

When an episode ends, Reelm continues with the same addon and the closest matching release it can find - same quality, same release group, same provider where the addon says - instead of picking whatever happens to be first in the list. If your addon has nothing close enough, it hands the choice back to you exactly as before. Subtitle and audio languages you pick by hand now carry over to the next episode too, instead of resetting every time.
